# JPLogic

> Engineering and technology services in Arlington Heights, Illinois, USA.

JPLogic supports new product development and services outdated but still-functional equipment. Its service areas are electronic design, legacy hardware, Internet of Things and blockchain technology.

Contact: jacek@jplogic.io

## Accuracy
Illustrations are AI-generated conceptual electronics, not documented JPLogic products. No customer counts, certifications, partnerships, guarantees or project results are claimed. Confirm scope, availability and commercial terms directly with JPLogic.

## Frequently asked questions

### What does JPLogic do?
JPLogic provides engineering and technology services in electronic design, legacy hardware service, Internet of Things, and blockchain technology.

### Can you support a new product idea?
Yes. Supporting customers with new product development (NPD) is part of JPLogic’s mission. Share your idea and the engineering support you are looking for to discuss the next steps.

### Do you work with older equipment?
Yes. JPLogic provides service for outdated but still functional equipment. Include the equipment details and the issue you are experiencing when you get in touch.

### Where is JPLogic located?
JPLogic is based in Arlington Heights, Illinois, USA.

### How can I discuss a project?
Email jacek@jplogic.io with a short description of your project or use the contact page to prepare an email. Include your goals and the type of support you need.
